source/841e0c91c1a87b016b50442f.md.title: Martin Wrigley · NHS Federated Data Platform: Palantir

hansard_summary.text: Wrigley asked for an independent audit of how widely the NHS uses the Federated Data Platform, how much it relies on it and what it would take to move away from it. He questioned whether the current contract helps the UK build its own capability.
